treatment_summary: The patient has very‑high‑risk ASCVD with uncontrolled lipids, hypertension, diabetes and hypertriglyceridaemia. Existing ACE‑I, CCB and thiazide therapy are continued. High‑intensity atorvastatin and low‑dose aspirin are added for lipid‑lowering and antiplatelet protection per CG126. Dapagliflozin is introduced for cardiovascular and renal benefit per NICE TA902/TA929. Icosapent ethyl is started to address persistent triglycerides per NICE CG181. All additions are checked for interactions, no contraindications are identified, and monitoring plans (renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, BP, lipids) are outlined. Assumptions regarding renal function, liver tests, BP, HR and allergies are flagged for confirmation.
